verdict.rationale: Rollbar has a documented REST API for listing/filtering top production items (e.g., error/critical, production environment) with stack trace data, and an official MCP server is documented, satisfying the 'pull top issues via API or MCP' part. However, there's no evidence of an end-to-end 'triage and file into tracker' agent workflow beyond the separate 'Resolve' AI agent that creates PRs (not filing bugs into an external tracker), and no OpenAPI spec was discoverable, limiting programmatic completeness. missing for 10: explicit MCP tool coverage for filing/creating tickets in external trackers, a documented OpenAPI spec, and hands-on/independent confirmation of an agent successfully triaging and filing bugs end-to-end.
